text:
Signal Veil - Horror Game Awards Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020814/

Signal Veil is a classic-style survival horror game coming to PS5.

After inheriting her mother’s old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, Aki must confront grotesque spirits, impossible messages, and a fractured reality.

Explore tense environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki’s phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what cannot normally be seen, and survive with limited resources and tactical combat.

Listen to the signal. Face what lies beyond the veil.

BrokenLore: Ascend - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016943

BrokenLore: Ascend launches on PS5® on January 7, 2027.

Climb to terrifying heights in a first-person psychological horror experience blending extreme climbing with supernatural horror inspired by the Rokurokubi, a terrifying yokai from Japanese folklore.

Follow two streamers as they attempt to climb a massive tower from the BrokenLore universe, officially created under license from Tokyo Tower.

At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Coming in 2027 on PlayStation®5. Wishlist now!
